en.headline: sogeisetsu: 14 commits to sopen-translate, plus 18 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-23, `sogeisetsu` made **14 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, alongside 18 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The day's work was mostly planning and documentation: the commit messages assess proxy options for Index-Translate, weigh browser free-translation routes from Edge, Google and on-device, and add a keyless Bilibili Index-Translate provider option. Further docs commits add a Microsoft Translator route with a targeted AI-repair phase and a KISS reference boundary, reconcile `AGENTS` guidance with batching, reasoning and real-device testing, and require a branch workflow while refreshing the remaining E/F execution plan. Performance work landed as well: providers now disable thinking per preset/model and fall back on a 400 response, while page batching rises to a budget of 8k/400 with 8 lanes, retries for failed batches, provider-policy batching, bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting. A final chore commit ignores locally installed agent skills. There were no pull requests, reviews, issues, releases or discussions in the window, and no section was truncated.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：sopen-translate 提交 14 次，另有 18 次自动提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，`sogeisetsu` 共完成 **14 次本人提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`；同一天，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 还有 `github-actions[bot]` 的 18 次自动提交。当天工作以规划和文档为主：提交内容评估了 Index-Translate 的代理方案，比较 Edge、Google 与端侧等浏览器免费翻译路径，并新增了无需密钥的 Bilibili Index-Translate 提供方选项。文档提交还加入了 Microsoft Translator 方案与定向 AI 修复阶段、KISS 参考边界，使 `AGENTS` 指引与批处理、推理、真机测试保持一致，并要求分支工作流、刷新剩余的 E/F 执行计划。性能方面也有改动：各提供方按预设/模型关闭 thinking，遇到 400 时回退；页面批处理预算提升至 8k/400，启用 8 条通道，失败批次重试，按提供方策略分批，并加入有界并发与自适应拆分。最后一次杂项提交忽略本地安装的 agent 技能。该时间窗口内没有拉取请求、评审、issue、发布或讨论，也没有任何部分被截断。
